finding.before: An opened composition streamed outside the global writer lock. Another store could commit a replacement and retire the prior directory while its iterator was suspended.
finding.reproducer: Install prior synthetic composition, consume only its first model chunk, replace it from a second store sharing the adapter. Before the fix replacement completes and retires the old directory before the reader finishes.
finding.correction: Shared per-composition leases for reads; exclusive leases for candidate writes and all installed-content retirement. App cached activation holds a withRead scope across six member transfers and worker activation. Companion opened-result validation requires callable withRead.
finding.identity: Current six-member binary composition and storage schemas unchanged; read-scope API and adapter lock contract updated coherently.

lockContract.ordering: Mutations acquire writer then composition. Read scopes acquire composition shared only and must not call store mutations.
lockContract.standalone: streamMember pins one iterator until completion/disposal.
lockContract.scoped: withRead closes unfinished iterators and cancels pending reads/callback waits before releasing its lease. Escaped scoped readers reject after closure.
lockContract.cancellation: Queued precommit candidate writes and explicit cleanup/recovery waits observe the caller signal. Postcommit best-effort retirement does not reinterpret an already committed pointer as cancellation.
lockContract.retirement: Prior bytes remain only while readers or a failed cleanup require them, then normal retirement removes them without recursive deletion.
lockContract.boundary: Web Locks coordinate cooperating origin clients; opened metadata alone does not pin retired bytes.

developmentResults.result: Replacement finished while prior member iterator was still open.

Companion exact activated field list rejected new withRead; an activation source assertion expected the prior direct call syntax. Updated the sole current bridge contract and assertion while preserving behavioral cancellation tests.

Test digest bytes were compared against hex text; old observer treated composition locks as global writer locks. Corrected hex encoding and separate exact lock accounting; one-global-writer invariant remains.
